text:
Peverell Semiconductors will lay off 310 employees, the company announced on 14 March 2025, in a restructuring that affects roughly 8 per cent of its 3,875-person workforce.

Marguerite Idowu-Hale, the company's chief executive officer, confirmed the cuts. The reduction is set out in a restructuring notice that Peverell filed with the Northmarch Securities Registry, a copy of which was reviewed by The Continental Record. Ms Idowu-Hale also referred to the notice during the company's first-quarter earnings call, where its contents were read out to analysts and investors.

The filing states that the 310 job losses form part of the company's wider restructuring plan. Peverell employs 3,875 people, according to the same documents.

The Registry notice is a public record and carries the company's formal commitments to shareholders. The Continental Record has relied on that filing and on the earnings call for the figures reported here.
